effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] You may reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Trash all Tamer cards among them. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you play a Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
